# Certified CPU controller, version 3

Extend the supplied FENIX CPU controller. Its model evaluators classify nine-packet length/IPD windows, its control-plane compiler builds a sampled probability table, and its reporting code aggregates window predictions into flows. Implement joint certified export planning between these stages. The fixed model assets are part of the contract, not a training task. Reserved service opportunities abstract the inference/link pipeline; this is an offline controller extension and makes no hardware-timing or learned-accuracy reproduction claim.

## Input

The entry is `python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py`, cwd /workspace. Read exactly one UTF-8 JSON object to EOF. Keys must be unique at every depth. Reject invalid UTF-8, trailing JSON, nonfinite numbers, booleans/decimal/exponent values in integer fields, unknown/missing keys, depth over64 containers, and every schema violation below. Input is at most16MiB. Invalid input returns exactly `{"error":"invalid"}` and exits0, with no partial results. Valid input returns `{"version":3,"results":[RESULT,...]}` in case order. Object order/whitespace are irrelevant; arrays have the specified order and JSON types are exact except for the report scalar number equivalence stated below.

Top-level keys: exactly `version,cases`. Version is integer3. cases has0–8 epochs; at most1024 total windows across the batch. Each epoch has exactly `model,class_values,stats,bucket,slots,flows,groups,windows`:

| Field | Meaning and bounds |
|---|---|
| model | exactly the string `cnn` or `rnn`, selecting the corresponding bundled seven-class model |
| class_values | seven integer utilities1–1000, indexed by predicted class |
| stats | `[N,Q,V]`, positive integers ≤10^9: global observations supplied to `probability.calculate_probability_model(Q,N,V)`; the table compiler converts its elapsed-time samples by dividing by1000 |
| bucket | `[B,I]`: capacity1–512 tokens, initial0–B |
| slots |1–256 rows `[time,capacity,refill]`: strictly increasing integer times0–10^12; service capacity0–512; refill0–512; first refill must be0 |
| flows |1–32 rows `[target,ceiling,group,label]`: target1–64, ceiling target–512; group=-1 or a group index; fixed true class label0–6 |
| groups |0–32 rows `[parent,ceiling]`: parent=-1 or a group index; parent links must be acyclic, in any input order; ceiling0–512 |
| windows |0–512 rows `[flow,ready,expires,T,C,draw,priority,features]`: flow is a zero-based flow index; ready0–10^12, expires ready–10^12; T1–65535, C1–320; draw0–65535; priority1–1000; features exactly nine `[length,IPD]` integer rows, length0–1500 and IPD0–2560, oldest first |

Each window row is a distinct indivisible candidate, identified by its input index. `ready` includes feature formation and fixed transfer lead time; `expires` is its last permitted export opportunity after accounting for the reserved inference pipeline. T and C are measured age and packet backlog from a preceding frozen observation period; choosing a window does not change another window's T,C. Any window may be assigned at most once, to a slot with ready≤time≤expires, and only if it passes its gate. Each flow receives at most its ceiling. A group limits the total selected windows of every flow attached to it or any descendant; all ancestor ceilings apply simultaneously. Group=-1 means no group; parent=-1 means a root. Groups may have no attached flows. These are explicit control-epoch resource policies; they are not classification labels. There is no required order among windows of the same flow and no extra FIFO constraint: slots are reserved service opportunities, not a simulation queue.

## Model predictions, compiled gates and finite tokens

For every window, including ones later rejected, run the selected evaluator's `evaluate_model_single_pass` on its features. The bundled `testcnnonnx.py`, `testrnnonnx.py`, `data_loader_npy.py`, assets and NumPy1.26.4/ONNX Runtime1.16.3 CPU path define the prediction primitive. Use one-window inference and the supplied one-thread sequential session settings. Its integer output is the lowest class index attaining the maximum first model output. CNN output is shape(1,7); RNN's shape(7) is intentional. No other model, training, randomized approximation or accelerator is needed. Window j has exact integer value priority_j*class_values[prediction_j]. These values affect planning; true labels affect only reports.

Compile the table once per epoch with the supplied `probability.calculate_probability_model(Q,N,V)`. Its published code, including the20x20 binary64 sampled grid, elapsed-time /1000 conversion, clipping, equality tolerance and floor-to65535 conversion, is the normative primitive. Look up the unique row whose inclusive elapsed and count ranges contain T,C; its last integer is the window threshold (default0 if no row). `window_thresholds` implements this lookup. A window passes exactly when draw<threshold. A threshold65535 rejects draw65535. Do not substitute an unsampled continuous formula or a different rounding rule. The public compiler is supplied and need not be reimplemented. Selected windows each consume one token and one service unit.

Initially I tokens are available at the first slot. At every later slot, add that slot's refill and discard tokens above B before allocating exports. Exports at a slot cannot exceed its service capacity or available tokens; unspent tokens carry to the next slot. No refill occurs between slots. Token sources may be unused: using an earlier available token instead of a later one has no objective advantage. Saturation can make a total-epoch token budget insufficient as a feasibility test.

## Objective and output

Let n_f be the number of chosen windows of flow f, and t_f its target. Coverage is r=min(1,min_f(n_f/t_f)). First maximize r. Among those allocations maximize U, the sum of chosen values. Among those minimize A, the sum of (assigned slot time-ready) for chosen windows. All ties are allowed; do not invent a tie-break. Even when r=0, the later objectives apply. An empty selection is always feasible, so every valid epoch has a solution.

A RESULT has exactly `predictions,reports,ratio,thresholds,assignment,utility,age,flow,potential,cut`:

- predictions contains one class0–6 per input window in input order.
- reports is `metrics.selected_report(flows,windows,predictions,assignment)` as specified below.
- ratio is `[p,q]` in lowest terms, 0≤p≤q≤64, q≥1, expressing optimal r.
- thresholds contains one exact threshold per input window.
- assignment contains one slot index or -1 per input window.
- utility and age are exact U,A.
- flow, potential, cut are the certificates defined next. They are required, not optional claims by the program.

## Selected-window reports

Report exactly `{"packet":METRICS,"stream":METRICS}`. Packet labels are the true flow label and predicted class of each selected window. A stream is a flow with at least one selected window; its predicted label is the most frequent selected-window class, breaking count ties by the earliest selected window in **input order**, independent of service order. Its true label is that flow's fixed label. No unselected window or unrepresented flow contributes to either report.

METRICS has exactly `confusion,accuracy,macro_precision,macro_recall,macro_f1`. Confusion is a7x7 integer matrix with true labels as rows and predicted labels as columns. For each class, precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), with zero for a zero denominator. Macro metrics average **all seven** classes, including absent classes. Accuracy is correct/total, or0 for an empty sample. Empty reports contain an all-zero confusion matrix and four zeros. The supplied metric routines implement these semantics and include empty-set handling. The four scalar metrics may use integer, decimal or exponent JSON number notation (for example1,1.0,1e0 are equivalent); booleans are not numbers. After standard Python JSON decoding, their values must be finite and within absolute1e-9 of the mathematical values, with no relative tolerance. Confusion and every other integer field remain exact JSON integers; decimal/exponent notation is not valid there. These reports describe selected classifications, not the optimization objective.

## Certificate coordinate system

This defines a constraint network solely to make certificates machine-checkable; no solver, graph constructor or optimizer is supplied. Let S,J,F,G be slot, window, flow and group counts. Node0 is a token source R; node1 a completion sink Z. For each slot s, nodes a_s=2+3s, b_s=3+3s, e_s=4+3s represent token intake, capped inventory and reserved service. Window j has node w_j=2+3S+j. Flow f has node z_f=2+3S+J+f. Group g has node h_g=2+3S+J+F+g. There are K=2+3S+J+F+G nodes. Let W=1+J*(last slot time). Every arc has lower0/cost0 unless specified. Construct the following ordered arc list; omit no zero-capacity arc:

1. For each slot s in order: R→a_s has capacity I for s=0, otherwise refill_s; a_s→b_s capacity B; if s+1<S, b_s→a_(s+1) capacity B; b_s→e_s capacity capacity_s. Within a slot use this stated order.
2. For every eligible (slot s,window j), in slot-major then window-index order, e_s→w_j has capacity1 and cost `(time_s-ready_j)-value_j*W`. Eligible means the window passes and ready_j≤time_s≤expires_j.
3. For each window j in order: w_j→z_(flow_j), capacity1.
4. For each flow f in order: z_f→h_(group_f), or z_f→Z if group=-1, lower ceil(r*target_f), capacity ceiling_f.
5. For each group g in order: h_g→h_(parent_g), or h_g→Z if parent=-1, capacity ceiling_g.
6. Z→R, capacity J.

A `flow` is an integer for every arc in this order, within its lower/capacity bounds, conserving flow at every node. An eligible-pair arc has flow1 exactly when assignment[j]=s; an unassigned window has none. Utility/age and r must agree with the assignment and objective. Any valid token provenance may be used; no particular carry/refill decomposition is required.

`potential` has one mathematical integer per node, each with absolute value ≤10^60. For every arc (u,v,l,h,c) with reported amount x, require c+potential[u]-potential[v]≥0 if x<h, and -c+potential[v]-potential[u]≥0 if x>l. No condition is imposed in a direction with no residual capacity. These inequalities certify the optimum of the final two objectives at the reported coverage. W makes one utility unit dominate the entire possible waiting-age range; it is a certificate cost convention, not a runtime or scoring threshold. Potentials need not be unique or normalized.

For maximal coverage, define the finite public set Rset={k/target_f: f ranges over flows, k=0..target_f}. The reported r must belong to this set. If r=1, cut must be null. Otherwise let r+ be the smallest Rset member strictly larger than r. Use the same arc list but replace each flow lower bound by ceil(r+*target_f). `cut` is a list of distinct node IDs describing a subset X for which **sum of lower bounds on arcs entering X exceeds sum of capacities on arcs leaving X**. Arcs wholly inside/outside do not contribute. This is an infeasibility obstruction for the next larger coverage; any such set, in any order, is accepted. A result must satisfy both the allocation and its certificates; a locally plausible allocation or an unproved objective is insufficient.

The public check supplies no allocation optimizer, objective evaluator or graph/certificate evaluator. It checks a tiny static result and JSON/CLI behavior. All constraints and the full domain above are normative.

# Submission and runtime boundaries

Submit a regular directory `submission/` with a regular UTF-8 `main.py`. Supporting modules, data and subdirectories are allowed: at most8MiB total regular-file bytes and256 entries including directories. Symlinks, multiply-linked files and special files are rejected for collection safety. NumPy1.26.4, ONNX Runtime1.16.3 and their pinned dependencies are bundled under /workspace/vendor; native runtime libraries are under /workspace/native. No download, training or native compilation is needed. Standard-library, bundled-package and submitted-module imports are allowed. Only frozen submission bytes are executed; editing public runner/checker/protocol files does not affect verification. The task provides CPython 3.11.14 on Linux x86-64, CPU only.

Each invocation handles the **whole** batch within 150 seconds wall time. Local worker limits are 180 CPU seconds soft /181 hard per process, 2 GiB address space per process, 64 processes/threads per reserved UID for the outer generic worker; the candidate child itself is restricted to one process/one thread by the public runner, 256 open descriptors per process, 64 MiB per regular file, zero core dumps. The inherited generic worker uses at most its first two available CPUs (no exclusive cores). Input ≤16 MiB, stdout ≤32 MiB, stderr ≤1 MiB. Limits apply to errors too; output overflow, empty/non-JSON/wrong output, nonzero exit, or timeout fails the invocation. A normal zero exit, including `os._exit(0)`, is accepted only if complete correct JSON actually reaches the stdout pipe. Text stdin/stdout, .buffer, raw descriptors 0/1, fileno(), and fdopen() all work. The public checker executes a separate bounded child and checks its actual bytes and exit status.

The local trial runs as a nonprivileged reserved UID in an allowlisted chroot with immutable runtime/source and clean environment. Only `/workspace/tmp` is writable and is cleared between invocations; it need not be used. Runtime files and standard `/dev/null`, `/dev/zero`, `/dev/random`, `/dev/urandom` are available; only a read-only /proc/cpuinfo CPU-descriptor snapshot is exposed (needed by the bundled inference runtime); no process /proc entries, /sys, credentials, private verifier, or solution is mounted. Networking (including loopback) is disabled. Socket/socketpair/connect; System V shared memory/semaphore/message queues; kill/tkill/tgkill; ptrace/process_vm_readv/process_vm_writev; unshare/setns; mount/umount2/pivot_root/chroot; setsid/setpgid; identity/group changes; open_by_handle_at/name_to_handle_at; bpf; keyctl/add_key/request_key; perf_event_open; userfaultfd; io_uring operations; and pidfd_getfd are denied with EPERM. The outer generic filter marks clone3 unavailable; the candidate runner returns EPERM for clone3, as observed in the actual child profile. Namespace-creating clone flags are denied. The candidate runner additionally denies fork, vfork, clone and clone3, so a candidate cannot create subprocesses/threads. Its parent can still launch the candidate and cleanly reap it. The runner also independently denies socket/socketpair/connect, kill/tkill/tgkill, ptrace, process_vm_readv/process_vm_writev, pidfd_open and pidfd_send_signal in the candidate child; its parent retains pidfd-based cleanup. The outer profile supplies the remaining listed restrictions. Non-x86-64 and x32 syscall ABIs are terminated. No resources outside this contract are necessary.

Source is run with -B; no site customization is submitted. Scratch is monitored approximately every 0.25 seconds: >1 GiB max(logical,allocated) file bytes or >50000 path entries triggers an **infrastructure error with no score**, not a precise quota. This local profile has no hard aggregate cgroup CPU/memory/storage guarantee and shares the host kernel. It is a local development/trial profile, not proof of hostile-kernel isolation. Formal container/transport validation remains pending separately.

`python3 public_check.py [--candidate PATH]` uses only this public workspace. Run it inside the supplied container or equivalent unprivileged development environment. It is a sanity checker and does not establish isolation by itself. It sets the same child resource limits, wall/output bounds and no-fork/no-socket filter without root; an outer container or worker supplies filesystem/UID and the remaining syscall restrictions. `python3 public_exec.py PATH` uses the same bounded child and relays its actual output/exit for local grading. Descendant creation is prevented, not left to an unbounded process-tree scan. It returns nonzero for candidate failure and never writes a reward. The private formal verifier is a separate image and remains fail-closed pending infrastructure validation. Runtime is a feasibility budget, not an optimization score or hardware-performance metric.

Native libraries use the bundled Ubuntu20.04 x86-64 libstdc++/libgcc10.5.0 and zlib1.2.11 copies; no native library path outside the public runtime is required.

The public runner observes SIGTERM/SIGINT during both pipe transfer and the final process-exit wait, including when the child has closed all pipes but stays alive. Repeated signals only mark cancellation while cleanup finishes. The child is killed and reaped before run returns or raises; the public checker stops starting fixtures after cancellation. Closing pipes is not process completion, a successful result or an escape from the same whole-batch deadline.

=== probability.py ===
"""CPU probability-table compiler and range lookup."""
import numpy as np

def calculate_probability_model(pkt_count, flow_count, feature_rate=75):
    
    N = flow_count if flow_count > 0 else 1
    V = feature_rate
    Q = pkt_count if pkt_count > 0 else 1
    
    threshold_NV = N / V
    threshold_QN = Q / N
    
    T_min, T_max = 1, 65535
    C_min, C_max = 1, 320
    num_samples_per_axis = 20 
    sample_T = np.linspace(T_min, T_max, num_samples_per_axis)
    sample_C = np.linspace(C_min, C_max, num_samples_per_axis)
    probability_table_data = []
    T_step = (T_max - T_min) // num_samples_per_axis
    C_step = (C_max - C_min) // num_samples_per_axis
    
    for i, T_i in enumerate(sample_T):
        for j, C_i in enumerate(sample_C):
            T_i_us = T_i / 1000
            Q_i = C_i / T_i_us
            P_i = 0
            if abs(C_i - (Q / N) * T_i_us) < 1e-3:
                P_i = 1 if T_i_us >= threshold_NV else 0
            elif C_i < (Q / N) * T_i_us:
                denominator1 = Q * T_i_us - N * C_i
                if denominator1 != 0 and T_i_us >= threshold_NV:
                    numerator1 = C_i * (V * T_i_us - N)
                    P_i = numerator1 / denominator1
            else:
                denominator2 = N * C_i - Q * T_i_us
                if denominator2 != 0 and V * C_i >= Q:
                    numerator2 = T_i_us * (V * C_i - Q)
                    P_i = numerator2 / denominator2
            P_i = max(0, min(1, P_i))
            T_low = int(T_min + i * T_step)
            T_high = int(T_min + (i + 1) * T_step - 1) if i < num_samples_per_axis - 1 else T_max
            C_low = int(C_min + j * C_step)
            C_high = int(C_min + (j + 1) * C_step - 1) if j < num_samples_per_axis - 1 else C_max
            
            prob_int = int(P_i * 65535)
            
            probability_table_data.append([1, T_low, T_high, C_low, C_high, prob_int])
    
    return probability_table_data

def window_thresholds(stats, windows):
    n, q, v = stats
    rows = calculate_probability_model(q, n, v)
    answer = []
    for window in windows:
        elapsed, packets = window[3], window[4]
        answer.append(next((int(row[5]) for row in rows
            if row[1] <= elapsed <= row[2] and row[3] <= packets <= row[4]), 0))
    return answer

"""Packet and flow classification reports, including empty selected sets."""
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import numpy as np

def compute_and_log_metrics(true_labels, pred_labels, num_classes=7):
    true_labels = np.array(true_labels, dtype=np.int64)
    pred_labels = np.array(pred_labels, dtype=np.int64)
    confusion_matrix_flat = np.bincount(

"""Traffic sequence storage, validation and CPU batch collation."""
import os
import numpy as np

class TrafficSequenceDatasetFromNPY:
    def __init__(self, data_file, labels_file, sequence_length=9):
        if not os.path.isfile(data_file):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Data file not found: {data_file}")
        if not os.path.isfile(labels_file):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Labels file not found: {labels_file}")
        self.sequences = np.load(data_file, allow_pickle=False)
        self.labels = np.load(labels_file, allow_pickle=False)
        self._validate(sequence_length)

    @classmethod
    def from_arrays(cls, sequences, labels, sequence_length=9):
        result = cls.__new__(cls)
        result.sequences = np.asarray(sequences, dtype=np.int64).reshape((-1,sequence_length,2))
        result.labels = np.asarray(labels, dtype=np.int64)
        result._validate(sequence_length)
        return result

    def _validate(self, sequence_length):
        if len(self.sequences) != len(self.labels):
            raise ValueError(f"Data length mismatch: {len(self.sequences)} vs {len(self.labels)}")
        self.sequences = self.sequences.astype(np.int64, copy=False)
        self.labels = self.labels.astype(np.int64, copy=False)
        if self.sequences.ndim != 3 or self.sequences.shape[1] != sequence_length:
            raise ValueError("Sequence length mismatch")
        if self.sequences.shape[2] != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"Feature dimension error: expected 2, got {self.sequences.shape[2]}")

    def __len__(self):
        return self.sequences.shape[0]

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        return self.sequences[index], self.labels[index]

def traffic_collate_fn_npy(batch):
    sequences, labels = zip(*batch)
    return np.stack(sequences, axis=0), np.asarray(labels,dtype=np.int64)

_SESSION = None

def evaluate_model_single_pass(sequences, labels):
    global _SESSION
    dataset = TrafficSequenceDatasetFromNPY.from_arrays(sequences, labels)
    if _SESSION is None:
        options = ort.SessionOptions()

        options.inter_op_num_threads = 1
        options.execution_mode = ort.ExecutionMode.ORT_SEQUENTIAL
        _SESSION = ort.InferenceSession(str(Path('/workspace/assets/rnn.onnx')),
            sess_options=options,providers=['CPUExecutionProvider'])
    session = _SESSION
    input_name = session.get_inputs()[0].name
    all_window_predictions = []
    batch_size = 1
    num_windows = len(dataset)
    num_batches = (num_windows + batch_size - 1) // batch_size
    for i in range(num_batches):
        start_idx = i * batch_size
        end_idx = min((i + 1) * batch_size, num_windows)
        batch_tensor_np, _ = traffic_collate_fn_npy([dataset[j] for j in range(start_idx,end_idx)])
        try:
            ort_inputs = {input_name: batch_tensor_np}

                predicted_batch = np.array([np.argmax(log_probs_output)])

"""Certified epoch planning for the FENIX CPU controller (version 3).

Implements, for one control epoch:

  * the certificate arc list of PROTOCOL.md (slot / window / flow / group nodes),
  * the maximum coverage ratio search (feasibility circulations, exact
    Fractions over the public ratio set),
  * the joint utility / waiting age optimisation as a min cost flow with a
    big-M cost and coverage reward arcs,
  * the feasible circulation, the residual node potentials and the
    next-ratio infeasibility cut, each verified before being emitted.
"""
import sys
from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right
from collections import deque
from fractions import Fraction

import graphlib as GL

BIG = 1 << 200


class Epoch(object):
    """Prepared epoch data plus the certificate arc list."""

    def __init__(self, model, class_values, stats, bucket, slots, flows,
                 groups, windows, preds):
        self.class_values = class_values
        self.stats = stats
        self.B, self.I = bucket
        self.slots = slots
        self.flows = flows
        self.groups = groups
        self.windows = windows
        self.preds = preds
        self.S = S = len(slots)
        self.J = J = len(windows)
        self.F = F = len(flows)
        self.G = G = len(groups)
        self.times = [r[0] for r in slots]
        self.qcap = [r[1] for r in slots]
        self.refill = [r[2] for r in slots]
        self.target = [r[0] for r in flows]
        self.ceiling = [r[1] for r in flows]
        self.fgroup = [r[2] for r in flows]
        self.gparent = [r[0] for r in groups]
        self.gceil = [r[1] for r in groups]
        self.ready = [w[1] for w in windows]
        self.expires = [w[2] for w in windows]
        self.wflow = [w[0] for w in windows]
        self.draw = [w[5] for w in windows]
        self.priority = [w[6] for w in windows]
        self.value = [self.priority[j] * class_values[preds[j]] for j in range(J)]
        self.W = 1 + J * self.times[-1]
        # head node of every flow arc / group arc
        self.znode = [2 + 3 * S + J + f for f in range(F)]
        self.hnode = [2 + 3 * S + J + F + g for g in range(G)]
        self.R = 0
        self.Z = 1
        self.fhead = [self.Z if self.fgroup[f] < 0 else self.hnode[self.fgroup[f]]
                      for f in range(F)]
        self.ghead = [self.Z if self.gparent[g] < 0 else self.hnode[self.gparent[g]]
                      for g in range(G)]
        self.K = 2 + 3 * S + J + F + G
        # eligibility: window -> slot index range
        self.lo = [0] * J
        self.hi = [-1] * J
        self.passes = [False] * J
        self.pslot = [[] for _ in range(S)]     # slot -> eligible window list
        self.arcs_lo = [0] * J
        self.arcs_hi = [-1] * J
        self._prepare_eligibility(thresholds=bucket)

    def _prepare_eligibility(self, thresholds):
        S = self.S
        times = self.times
        for j in range(self.J):
            self.arcs_lo[j] = bisect_left(times, self.ready[j])
            self.arcs_hi[j] = bisect_right(times, self.expires[j]) - 1
        self.elo = self.arcs_lo
        self.ehi = self.arcs_hi


def build_arc_lists(ep, low):
    """Certificate arc list (order fixed by PROTOCOL.md) as five parallel lists.

    `low` is the per flow lower bound vector; only flow arcs carry lowers.
    Returns (tail, head, lower, capa, cost, marks) where marks records the arc
    index of every structural group.
    """
    S, J, F, G = ep.S, ep.J, ep.F, ep.G
    tail = []
    head = []
    lower = []
    capa = []
    cost = []

    def add(u, v, l, h, c):
        tail.append(u)
        head.append(v)
        lower.append(l)
        capa.append(h)
        cost.append(c)
        return len(tail) - 1

    slot_arcs = []
    for s in range(S):
        a = 2 + 3 * s
        b = 3 + 3 * s
        e = 4 + 3 * s
        blk = []
        blk.append(add(ep.R, a, 0, ep.I if s == 0 else ep.refill[s], 0))
        blk.append(add(a, b, 0, ep.B, 0))
        if s + 1 < S:
            blk.append(add(b, a + 3, 0, ep.B, 0))
        else:
            blk.append(-1)
        blk.append(add(b, e, 0, ep.qcap[s], 0))
        slot_arcs.append(blk)
    dense_start = len(tail)
    wbase = 2 + 3 * S
    for s in range(S):
        e = 4 + 3 * s
        for j in ep.pslot[s]:
            add(e, wbase + j, 0, 1,
                (ep.times[s] - ep.ready[j]) - ep.value[j] * ep.W)
    dense_end = len(tail)
    win_arcs = []
    for j in range(J):
        win_arcs.append(add(wbase + j, ep.znode[ep.wflow[j]], 0, 1, 0))
    flow_arcs = []
    for f in range(F):
        flow_arcs.append(add(ep.znode[f], ep.fhead[f], low[f], ep.ceiling[f], 0))
    group_arcs = []
    for g in range(G):
        group_arcs.append(add(ep.hnode[g], ep.ghead[g], 0, ep.gceil[g], 0))
    back_arc = add(ep.Z, ep.R, 0, J, 0)
    marks = (slot_arcs, dense_start, dense_end, win_arcs, flow_arcs,
             group_arcs, back_arc)
    return tail, head, lower, capa, cost, marks


class Planner(object):
    def __init__(self, ep):
        self.ep = ep
        self.rset = self._ratio_set()

    def _ratio_set(self):
        vals = set()
        for t in self.ep.target:
            for k in range(t + 1):
                if k <= t:
                    fr = Fraction(k, t)
                    if fr <= 1:
                        vals.add(fr)
        return sorted(vals)

    # ---------------- feasibility -------------------------------------
    def build_aux(self, nlow):
        """Auxiliary demand network for the feasibility circulation.

        feeds nodes with positive imbalance, nodes with negative imbalance
        feed the super sink.  Returns (graph, base_caps, arcmap).
        """
        ep = self.ep

        tail, head, lower, capa, cost, marks = nlow
        base = []
        arcmap = []
        for i in range(len(tail)):

            arcmap.append(a)

        # flow arcs and imbalance arcs depend on the lower bound vector
        d = [0] * ep.K
        for i in range(len(tail)):
            if lower[i]:
                pass

"""Certified epoch planning for the FENIX CPU controller (protocol version 3).

One epoch is planned in four steps.

1.  The certificate arc list of PROTOCOL.md is materialised as five parallel
    integer lists (tail, head, lower, capacity, cost) in the mandated order.
2.  The optimal coverage ratio is searched over the public ratio set with
    feasibility circulations (Hoffman theorem via Dinic); the failing run for
    the next ratio yields the infeasibility cut.
3.  Utility and waiting age are optimised jointly with the big-M arc costs of
    the certificate network, using a primal dual min cost flow between the
    token source and the completion sink.  Coverage lower bounds enter as
    reward arcs whose weight dominates the whole objective range, so the
    returned flow is optimal for the lexicographic objective at the proved
    coverage ratio.
4.  The node potentials are read off the final dual prices (with the return
    arc handled by a monotone shift), and everything is verified against the
    published constraints before emission.
"""
from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right
from collections import deque
from fractions import Fraction

import graphlib as GL

INF = 1 << 400


class Plan(object):
    """Everything needed to plan and certify a single control epoch."""

    def __init__(self, class_values, bucket, slots, flows, groups, windows,
                 preds, thresholds):
        self.class_values = class_values
        self.B, self.I = bucket
        self.slots = slots
        self.flows = flows
        self.groups = groups

        self.preds = preds
        self.thresholds = thresholds
        S = self.S = len(slots)
        J = self.J = len(windows)
        F = self.F = len(flows)
        G = self.G = len(groups)
        self.times = [r[0] for r in slots]
        self.qcap = [r[1] for r in slots]
        self.refill = [r[2] for r in slots]
        self.target = [r[0] for r in flows]
        self.ceiling = [r[1] for r in flows]
        self.fgroup = [r[2] for r in flows]
        self.gparent = [r[0] for r in groups]
        self.gceil = [r[1] for r in groups]
        self.wflow = [w[0] for w in windows]
        self.ready = [w[1] for w in windows]
        self.expires = [w[2] for w in windows]
        self.draw = [w[5] for w in windows]
        self.priority = [w[6] for w in windows]
        self.label = [f[3] for f in flows]
        self.value = [self.priority[j] * class_values[preds[j]] for j in range(J)]
        self.W = 1 + J * self.times[-1]
        self.R = 0
        self.Z = 1
        self.abase = 2
        self.wbase = 2 + 3 * S
        self.zbase = self.wbase + J
        self.hbase = self.zbase + F
        self.K = self.hbase + G
        self.fhead = [self.Z if self.fgroup[f] < 0 else self.hbase + self.fgroup[f]
                      for f in range(F)]
        self.ghead = [self.Z if self.gparent[g] < 0 else self.hbase + self.gparent[g]
                      for g in range(G)]
        # eligibility windows per slot, slot-major order
        self.elo = [bisect_left(self.times, self.ready[j]) for j in range(J)]
        self.ehi = [bisect_right(self.times, self.expires[j]) - 1 for j in range(J)]
        self.passes = [self.draw[j] < thresholds[j] for j in range(J)]
        pslot = [[] for _ in range(S)]
        for j in range(J):
            if self.passes[j]:
                hi = self.ehi[j]
                if hi >= self.S:
                    hi = self.S - 1
                for s in range(self.elo[j], hi + 1):
                    pslot[s].append(j)
        self.pslot = pslot
        self.rset = self._ratio_set()

    def _ratio_set(self):
        vals = set()
        for t in self.target:
            for k in range(t + 1):
                fr = Fraction(k, t)
                if fr <= 1:
                    vals.add(fr)
        return sorted(vals)

    def lowers(self, ratio):
        """ceil(ratio * target) per flow, exact integer arithmetic."""
        p = ratio.numerator
        q = ratio.denominator
        t = self.target
        return [(-((-p * ti) // q)) for ti in t]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # certificate arc list
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def build_arcs(self, low):
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        tail = []
        head = []
        lower = []
        capa = []
        cost = []
        ap = tail.append

        def add(u, v, l, h, c):
            ap(u)
            head.append(v)
            lower.append(l)
            capa.append(h)
            cost.append(c)
            return len(tail) - 1

        for s in range(S):
            a = self.abase + 3 * s
            b = a + 1
            e = a + 2
            blk = [add(self.R, a, 0, self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s], 0),

        self.dense_end = dense_end

        self.flow_arc = flow_arc
        self.group_arc = group_arc

        self.tail = tail
        self.head = head
        self.lower = lower
        self.capa = capa
        self.cost = cost
        return tail, head, lower, capa, cost

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # feasibility circulation for a lower bound vector
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def build_aux(self):
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        n = self.K + 2
        SS = self.K
        TT = self.K + 1
        g = GL.Graph(n)
        arcmap = [0] * len(self.tail)
        for i in range(len(self.tail)):
            arcmap[i] = g.add(self.tail[i], self.head[i], 0)
        heads = sorted(set(self.fhead))
        ss_arc = {}
        for v in heads:
            ss_arc[v] = g.add(SS, v, 0)
        tt_arc = [g.add(self.zbase + f, TT, 0) for f in range(F)]
        self.aux_g = g
        self.aux_arcmap = arcmap
        self.aux_ss = ss_arc
        self.aux_tt = tt_arc
        self.aux_SS = SS
        self.aux_TT = TT
        self.aux_heads = heads

    def feasible(self, low, keep=False):
        """True if a feasible circulation realises the lower bound vector."""
        g = self.aux_g
        arcmap = self.aux_arcmap
        cap = [0] * len(g.cap)
        S, J, F = self.S, self.J, self.F
        for s in range(S):
            blk = self.slot_blk[s]
            cap[arcmap[blk[0]]] = self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s]
            cap[arcmap[blk[1]]] = self.B
            if blk[2] >= 0:

            cap[arcmap[blk[3]]] = self.qcap[s]
        for a in range(self.dense_start, self.dense_end):

        for a in self.win_arc:

        demand = {}

            h = self.fhead[f]
            supply[h] = supply.get(h, 0) + l
            zf = self.zbase + f
            demand[zf] = demand.get(zf, 0) + l
        for v, amt in supply.items():
            cap[self.aux_ss[v]] = amt
        for v, amt in demand.items():

            pass
        for f in range(F):
            cap[self.aux_tt[f]] = low[f]

                         limit=total)
        if val >= total:
            return True, None
        seen = GL.reachable(self.K + 2, g.adj, g.to, cap, self.aux_SS)
        return False, seen

    def ratio_search(self):
        """Largest feasible member of the public ratio set."""
        cands = self.rset
        lo = 0
        hi = len(cands) - 1
        best = 0            # index of the best known feasible ratio (cands[0]==0)

                cache[mid] = ok

                lo = mid + 1
            else:

                cache[hi + 1] = False

        ok, seen = self.feasible(low)
        if ok or seen is None:

        K = self.K
        X = [v for v in range(K) if seen[v]]

"""Residual graph primitives used by the certified export planner.

Flat adjacency arrays (arc index pairs i / i^1 are the forward and backward
residuals) keep the inner loops cheap.  Every quantity is an exact Python
integer: certificate costs contain the big-M weight of PROTOCOL.md and do not
fit into machine words.
"""
from collections import deque
from heapq import heappush, heappop

BIG = 1 << 200


class Graph(object):
    __slots__ = ('n', 'adj', 'to', 'cap', 'cost')

    def __init__(self, n, costed=False):
        self.n = n
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.to = []
        self.cap = []
        self.cost = [] if costed else None

    def add(self, u, v, c, w=0):
        idx = len(self.to)
        self.to.append(v)
        self.cap.append(c)
        self.adj[u].append(idx)
        self.to.append(u)
        self.cap.append(0)
        self.adj[v].append(idx + 1)
        if self.cost is not None:
            self.cost.append(w)
            self.cost.append(-w)
        return idx


def maxflow(n, adj, to, cap, s, t, limit=None):
    """Dinic maximum flow, mutating `cap`; stops early at `limit`."""
    flow = 0
    level = [-1] * n
    while True:
        for i in range(n):
            level[i] = -1
        level[s] = 0
        q = deque((s,))
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            nl = level[u] + 1
            for a in adj[u]:
                if cap[a] > 0:
                    v = to[a]
                    if level[v] < 0:
                        level[v] = nl
                        q.append(v)
        if level[t] < 0:
            break
        it = [0] * n

        def dfs(u, f):
            if u == t:
                return f
            au = adj[u]
            lu = level[u] + 1
            i = it[u]
            while i < len(au):
                a = au[i]
                v = to[a]
                ca = cap[a]
                if ca > 0 and level[v] == lu:
                    r = dfs(v, f if f < ca else ca)
                    if r:
                        cap[a] -= r
                        cap[a ^ 1] += r
                        return r
                i += 1
                it[u] = i
            level[u] = -1
            return 0

        while True:
            room = BIG if limit is None else limit - flow
            if room <= 0:
                return flow
            f = dfs(s, room)
            if not f:
                break
            flow += f
    return flow


def reachable(n, adj, to, cap, s):
    seen = [False] * n
    seen[s] = True
    stack = [s]
    while stack:
        u = stack.pop()
        for a in adj[u]:
            if cap[a] > 0:
                v = to[a]
                if not seen[v]:
                    seen[v] = True
                    stack.append(v)
    return seen


def pot_from_dag(n, adj, to, cap, cost, order):
    """Shortest distances from a virtual source in a costed DAG."""
    d = [0] * n
    for u in order:
        du = d[u]
        for a in adj[u]:
            if cap[a] > 0:
                v = to[a]
                nd = du + cost[a]
                if nd < d[v]:
                    d[v] = nd
    return d


def mincost_negative_augment(n, adj, to, cap, cost, pot, source, sink, maxf):
    """Primal dual augmentation while extra flow strictly helps.

    `pot` must make every residual reduced cost non negative.  Units are
    pushed along cheapest paths while their true cost is negative, which for
    the certificate costs is exactly the lexicographic optimum over the flow
    value (every export carries positive utility).  pot is dual feasible for
    the residual graph of the returned flow.
    """
    p = pot
    units = 0
    total = 0
    INF = BIG * BIG
    while units < maxf:
        dist = [INF] * n
        prev = [-1] * n
        done = [False] * n
        dist[source] = 0
        heap = [(0, source)]
        hit = False
        while heap:
            du, u = heappop(heap)
            if done[u] or dist[u] != du:
                continue
            if u == sink:
                hit = True
                break
            done[u] = True
            pu = p[u]
            for a in adj[u]:
                if cap[a] > 0:
                    v = to[a]
                    if done[v]:
                        continue
                    nd = du + cost[a] + pu - p[v]
                    if nd < dist[v]:
                        dist[v] = nd
                        prev[v] = a
                        heappush(heap, (nd, v))
        if not hit:
            break
        delta = dist[sink]
        pathcost = delta + p[sink] - p[source]
        for v in range(n):
            if done[v]:
                dv = dist[v]
                p[v] += dv if dv < delta else delta
            else:
                p[v] += delta
        if pathcost >= 0:
            break
        f = maxf - units
        v = sink
        while v != source:
            a = prev[v]
            ca = cap[a]
            if ca < f:
                f = ca
            v = to[a ^ 1]
        v = sink
        while v != source:
            a = prev[v]
            cap[a] -= f
            cap[a ^ 1] += f
            v = to[a ^ 1]
        units += f
        total += f * pathcost
    return units, total, p


def feasible_potential(n, adj, to, cost, d, dirty):
    """Repair node potentials so that d[v] <= d[u] + cost(u,v) on every arc.

    Bellman Ford queue scheme; only decreases.  `dirty` lists nodes whose value
    was already lowered.  Returns ok (False when the iteration guard tripped).
    """
    inflag = [False] * n
    q = deque()
    for v in dirty:
        if not inflag[v]:
            inflag[v] = True
            q.append(v)
    pops = 0
    guard = 30 * (len(cost) + 4 * n + 64) + 1000
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        inflag[u] = False
        du = d[u]
        au = adj[u]
        for i in range(len(au)):
            a = au[i]
            v = to[a]
            nd = du + cost[a]
            if nd < d[v]:
                d[v] = nd
                if not inflag[v]:
                    inflag[v] = True
                    q.append(v)
        pops += 1
        if pops > guard:
            return False
    return True
PYEOF

        self.expires = [w[2] for w in windows]
        self.draw = [w[5] for w in windows]
        self.priority = [w[6] for w in windows]
        self.value = [self.priority[j] * max(preds[j], 0) * 0 for j in range(J)]
        self.value = None          # filled by caller through set_values
        self.R = 0
        self.Z = 1
        self.abase = 2
        self.wbase = 2 + 3 * S
        self.zbase = self.wbase + J
        self.hbase = self.zbase + F
        self.K = self.hbase + G
        self.fhead = [self.Z if self.fgroup[f] < 0 else self.hbase + self.fgroup[f]
                      for f in range(F)]
        self.ghead = [self.Z if self.gparent[g] < 0 else self.hbase + self.gparent[g]
                      for g in range(G)]
        self.elo = [bisect_left(self.times, self.ready[j]) for j in range(J)]
        self.ehi = [min(bisect_right(self.times, self.expires[j]) - 1, S - 1)
                    for j in range(J)]
        self.passes = [self.draw[j] < thresholds[j] for j in range(J)]
        pslot = [[] for _ in range(S)]
        for j in range(J):
            if self.passes[j]:
                for s in range(self.elo[j], self.ehi[j] + 1):
                    pslot[s].append(j)
        self.pslot = pslot
        self.rset = self._ratio_set()
        self.assignment = [-1] * J
        self.nsel = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_values(self, value, W):
        self.value = value
        self.W = W

    def _ratio_set(self):
        vals = set()
        for t in self.target:
            for k in range(t + 1):
                fr = Fraction(k, t)
                if fr <= 1:
                    vals.add(fr)
        return sorted(vals)

    def lowers(self, ratio):
        p = ratio.numerator
        q = ratio.denominator
        return [-((-p * ti) // q) for ti in self.target]

    # ---------------- certificate arc list --------------------------------
    def build_arcs(self, low):
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        tail = []
        head = []
        lower = []
        capa = []
        cost = []

        def add(u, v, l, h, c):
            tail.append(u)
            head.append(v)
            lower.append(l)
            capa.append(h)
            cost.append(c)
            return len(tail) - 1

        slot_blk = []
        for s in range(S):
            a = self.abase + 3 * s
            blk = [add(self.R, a, 0, self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s], 0),
                   add(a, a + 1, 0, self.B, 0)]
            if s + 1 < S:
                blk.append(add(a + 1, a + 3, 0, self.B, 0))
            else:
                blk.append(-1)
            blk.append(add(a + 1, a + 2, 0, self.qcap[s], 0))
            slot_blk.append(blk)
        dense_start = len(tail)
        for s in range(S):
            e = self.abase + 3 * s + 2
            ts = self.times[s]
            for j in self.pslot[s]:
                add(e, self.wbase + j, 0, 1,
                    (ts - self.ready[j]) - self.value[j] * self.W)
        dense_end = len(tail)
        win_arc = [add(self.wbase + j, self.zbase + self.wflow[j], 0, 1, 0)
                   for j in range(J)]
        flow_arc = [add(self.zbase + f, self.fhead[f], low[f], self.ceiling[f], 0)
                    for f in range(F)]
        group_arc = [add(self.hbase + g, self.ghead[g], 0, self.gceil[g], 0)
                     for g in range(G)]
        back = add(self.Z, self.R, 0, J, 0)
        self.slot_blk = slot_blk
        self.dense_start = dense_start
        self.dense_end = dense_end
        self.win_arc = win_arc
        self.flow_arc = flow_arc
        self.group_arc = group_arc
        self.back_arc = back
        self.tail = tail
        self.head = head
        self.lower = lower
        self.capa = capa
        self.cost = cost

    # ---------------- feasibility circulation -----------------------------
    def build_aux(self):
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        n = self.K + 2
        self.SS = self.K
        self.TT = self.K + 1
        g = GL.Graph(n)
        arcmap = [g.add(self.tail[i], self.head[i], 0)
                  for i in range(len(self.tail))]
        base = [0] * len(g.cap)
        for s in range(S):
            blk = self.slot_blk[s]
            base[arcmap[blk[0]]] = self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s]
            base[arcmap[blk[1]]] = self.B
            if blk[2] >= 0:
                base[arcmap[blk[2]]] = self.B
            base[arcmap[blk[3]]] = self.qcap[s]
        for a in range(self.dense_start, self.dense_end):
            base[arcmap[a]] = 1
        for a in self.win_arc:
            base[arcmap[a]] = 1
        for gg in range(G):
            base[arcmap[self.group_arc[gg]]] = self.gceil[gg]
        base[arcmap[self.back_arc]] = J
        ss_arc = {}
        for v in sorted(set(self.fhead)):
            ss_arc[v] = g.add(self.SS, v, 0)
        tt_arc = [g.add(self.zbase + f, self.TT, 0) for f in range(F)]
        self.aux_g = g
        self.aux_map = arcmap
        self.aux_base = base
        self.aux_ss = ss_arc
        self.aux_tt = tt_arc
        self.aux_n = n

    def feasible(self, low, need_cut=False):
        g = self.aux_g
        amap = self.aux_map
        cap = self.aux_base[:]
        flowmap = self.flow_arc
        for f in range(self.F):
            ce = self.ceiling[f] - low[f]
            cap[amap[flowmap[f]]] = ce if ce > 0 else 0
        supply = {}
        for f in range(self.F):
            l = low[f]
            if l:
                h = self.fhead[f]
                supply[h] = supply.get(h, 0) + l
            cap[self.aux_tt[f]] = l
        for v, amt in supply.items():
            cap[self.aux_ss[v]] = amt
        total = sum(low)
        if total == 0:
            return True, None
        val = GL.maxflow(self.aux_n, g.adj, g.to, cap, self.SS, self.TT,
                         limit=total)
        if val >= total:
            return True, None
        if not need_cut:
            return False, None
        seen = GL.reachable(self.aux_n, g.adj, g.to, cap, self.SS)
        return False, [v for v in range(self.K) if seen[v]]

    # ---------------- coverage search -------------------------------------
    def ratio_search(self):
        cands = self.rset
        lo = 0
        hi = len(cands) - 1
        best = 0
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            ok, _ = self.feasible(self.lowers(cands[mid]))
            if ok:
                best = mid
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid - 1
        return best

    # ---------------- min cost planning -----------------------------------
    def build_opt(self, low):
        S, J, F, G, K = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G, self.K
        g = GL.Graph(K, costed=True)
        cimap = [0] * len(self.tail)
        for s in range(S):
            blk = self.slot_blk[s]
            for k in (0, 1, 2, 3):
                a = blk[k]
                if a < 0:
                    continue
                cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], self.capa[a], 0)
        self.odense = g.n_arcs if hasattr(g, 'n_arcs') else len(g.to)
        for a in range(self.dense_start, self.dense_end):
            cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], 1, self.cost[a])
        owint = []
        for j in range(J):
            a = self.win_arc[j]
            owint.append(g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], 1, 0))
        P = self.big_m(low)
        urew = []
        urest = []
        for f in range(F):
            z = self.zbase + f
            h = self.fhead[f]
            urew.append(g.add(z, h, low[f], -P))
            urest.append(g.add(z, h, self.ceiling[f] - low[f], 0))
        ugrp = []
        for gg in range(G):
            a = self.group_arc[gg]
            ugrp.append(g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], self.gceil[gg], 0))
        self.opt_g = g
        self.cimap = cimap
        self.owint = owint
        self.urew = urew
        self.urest = urest
        self.ugrp = ugrp
        self.P = P
        return g

    def big_m(self, low):
        J = self.J
        vmax = 1
        for v in self.value:
            if v > vmax:
                vmax = v
        tmax = self.times[-1]
        return self.W * (J * vmax + 1) + J * (tmax + 1) + 1

    def dag_order(self):
        order = [self.R]
        for s in range(self.S):
            a = self.abase + 3 * s
            order.append(a)
            order.append(a + 1)
            order.append(a + 2)
        for j in range(self.J):
            order.append(self.wbase + j)
        for f in range(self.F):
            order.append(self.zbase + f)
        for gg in self.group_topo():
            order.append(self.hbase + gg)
        order.append(self.Z)
        return order

    def group_topo(self):
        G = self.G
        depth = [0] * G
        state = [0] * G
        for i in range(G):
            if state[i]:
                continue
            chain = []
            cur = i
            while cur >= 0 and state[cur] == 0:
                state[cur] = 1
                chain.append(cur)
                cur = self.gparent[cur]
            base = depth[cur] if cur >= 0 else -1
            for node in reversed(chain):
                state[node] = 2
                base = base + 1
                depth[node] = base
        return sorted(range(G), key=lambda i: -depth[i])

    def optimise(self, low):
        S, J, F, G, K = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G, self.K
        g = self.build_opt(low)
        pot = GL.pot_from_dag(K, g.adj, g.to, g.cap, g.cost, self.dag_order())
        units, total, pot = GL.mincost_negative_augment(
            K, g.adj, g.to, g.cap, g.cost, pot, self.R, self.Z, J)
        self.opt_pot = pot
        cap = g.cap
        # assignment from the dense arcs
        asg = [-1] * J
        used = [False] * J
        pairs_slot = []
        for s in range(S):
            for j in self.pslot[s]:
                pairs_slot.append((s, j))
        base = self.odense
        for t in range(len(pairs_slot)):
            if cap[base + 2 * t] == 0:
                s, j = pairs_slot[t]
                asg[j] = s
        self.odense_pairs = pairs_slot
        nsel = 0
        for j in range(J):
            if asg[j] >= 0:
                nsel += 1
                used[j] = True
        self.assignment = asg
        self.nsel = nsel
        nf = []
        for f in range(F):
            a = self.urew[f]
            b = self.urest[f]
            nf.append((low[f] - cap[a]) + (self.ceiling[f] - low[f] - cap[b]))
        self.nf = nf
        self.opt_flow = cap
        return units, total

    # ---------------- certificate assembly --------------------------------
    def spec_flow(self, low):
        cap = self.opt_flow
        cimap = self.cimap
        flow = [0] * len(self.tail)
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        for i in range(len(self.tail)):
            if self.dense_start <= i < self.dense_end:
                continue
            c = cimap[i]
            flow[i] = self.capa[i] - cap[c] if i not in () else 0
        # flow arcs are split in the optimiser
        for f in range(F):
            i = self.flow_arc[f]
            a = self.urew[f]
            b = self.urest[f]
            flow[i] = (low[f] - cap[a]) + (self.ceiling[f] - low[f] - cap[b])
        base = self.odense
        pairs = self.odense_pairs
        for t in range(len(pairs)):
            if cap[base + 2 * t] == 0:
                flow[self.dense_start + t] = 1
        flow[self.back_arc] = self.nsel
        self.arcflow = flow
        return flow

    def objectives(self):
        asg = self.assignment
        U = 0
        A = 0
        for j in range(self.J):
            s = asg[j]
            if s >= 0:
                U += self.value[j]
                A += self.times[s] - self.ready[j]
        self.utility = U
        self.age = A
        return U, A

    # ---------------- potentials ------------------------------------------
    def residual_graph(self, flow, low):
        """Directed residual arcs of the certificate network at `flow`."""
        tail = self.tail
        head = self.head
        capa = self.capa
        cost = self.cost
        lower = [0] * len(tail)
        for f in range(self.F):
            lower[self.flow_arc[f]] = low[f]
        radj = [[] for _ in range(self.K)]
        rto = []
        rcost = []
        for i in range(len(tail)):
            u = tail[i]
            v = head[i]
            x = flow[i]
            c = cost[i]
            if x < capa[i]:
                idx = len(rto)
                rto.append(v)
                rcost.append(c)
                radj[u].append(idx)
            if x > lower[i]:
                idx = len(rto)
                rto.append(u)
                rcost.append(-c)
                radj[v].append(idx)
        # force the return arc equality in both directions
        for (u, v) in ((self.R, self.Z), (self.Z, self.R)):
            idx = len(rto)
            rto.append(v)
            rcost.append(0)
            radj[u].append(idx)
        self.radjs = radj
        self.rto = rto
        self.rcost = rcost
        return radj, rto, rcost

    def potentials(self, flow, low):
        K = self.K
        p = self.opt_pot[:]
        t = p[self.R] if p[self.R] < p[self.Z] else p[self.Z]
        dirty = []
        if p[self.R] != t:
            p[self.R] = t
            dirty.append(self.R)
        if p[self.Z] != t:
            p[self.Z] = t
            dirty.append(self.Z)
        if not dirty:
            dirty = [self.R, self.Z]
        GL.feasible_potential(K, self.radjs, self.rto, self.rcost, p, dirty)
        for v in range(K):
            if p[v] > 10 ** 60 or p[v] < -10 ** 60:
                return None
        if not self.check_potentials(p):
            return None
        return p

    def check_potentials(self, p):
        tail = self.tail
        head = self.head
        capa = self.capa
        flow = self.arcflow
        cost = self.cost
        lower = [0] * len(tail)
        for f in range(self.F):
            lower[self.flow_arc[f]] = low_holder(self)[f]
        for i in range(len(tail)):
            u = tail[i]
            v = head[i]
            x = flow[i]
            c = cost[i]
            if x < capa[i] and c + p[u] - p[v] < 0:
                return False
            if x > lower[i] and -c + p[v] - p[u] < 0:
                return False
        return True

    # ---------------- verification ----------------------------------------
    def verify(self, ratio, low, cut):
        ep = self
        S, J, F, G = ep.S, ep.J, ep.F, ep.G
        flow = ep.arcflow
        tail = ep.tail
        head = ep.head
        capa = ep.capa
        if len(flow) != len(tail):
            return False
        bal = [0] * ep.K
        for i in range(len(tail)):
            x = flow[i]
            if x < 0 or x > capa[i]:
                return False
            if x < ep.lower_arc_value(i, low):
                return False
            bal[tail[i]] -= x
            bal[head[i]] += x
        if any(b != 0 for b in bal):
            return False
        # dense arcs mirror the assignment
        pairs = ep.odense_pairs
        for t in range(len(pairs)):
            s, j = pairs[t]
            want = 1 if ep.assignment[j] == s else 0
            if flow[ep.dense_start + t] != want:
                return False
        U, A = ep.objectives()
        if U != ep.utility or A != ep.age:
            return False
        # coverage
        for f in range(F):
            if ep.nf[f] < low[f]:
                return False
        r = Fraction(1, 1)
        for f in range(F):
            fr = Fraction(ep.nf[f], ep.target[f])
            if fr < r:
                r = fr
        if r > 1:
            r = Fraction(1, 1)
        if r != ratio:
            return False
        if ep.pot is None or not ep.check_potentials(ep.pot):
            return False
        if ratio == 1:
            if cut is not None:
                return False
        else:
            if not cut:
                return False
            if not ep.verify_cut(cut, low):
                return False
        return True

    def lower_arc_value(self, i, low):
        for f in range(self.F):
            if self.flow_arc[f] == i:
                return low[f]
        return 0

    def verify_cut(self, cut, low):
        """sum lowers entering X > sum capacities leaving X."""
        K = self.K
        inside = [False] * K
        for v in cut:
            if v < 0 or v >= K:
                return False
            inside[v] = True
        lowers = [0] * len(self.tail)
        for f in range(self.F):
            lowers[self.flow_arc[f]] = low[f]
        ein = 0
        eout = 0
        for i in range(len(self.tail)):
            u = self.tail[i]
            v = self.head[i]
            if inside[u] and not inside[v]:
                eout += self.capa[i]
            elif (not inside[u]) and inside[v]:
                ein += lowers[i]
        return ein > eout

    def report(self):
        return metrics.selected_report(self.flows, self.windows, self.preds,
                                       self.assignment)


def low_holder(ep):
    return ep.lower_arc


def solve_epoch(bucket, slots, flows, groups, windows, preds, thresholds,
                value, W):
    ep = Plan(bucket, slots, flows, groups, windows, preds, thresholds)
    ep.set_values(value, W)
    idx = ep.ratio_search()
    ratio = ep.rset[idx]
    low = ep.lowers(ratio)
    ep.build_arcs(low)
    ep.build_aux()
    # the arc list was rebuilt with the final lowers: redo the auxiliary graph
    ep.build_aux()
    ep.optimise(low)
    ep.spec_flow(low)
    ep.objectives()
    ep.lower_arc = low
    cut = None
    if ratio < 1:
        cut = ep.cut_for(idx)
    ep.pot = ep.potentials(ep.arcflow, low)
    ok = False
    try:
        ok = ep.verify(ratio, low, cut)
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    if not ok:
        cut = ep.fallback_cut(idx, ratio)
        ep.pot = ep.potentials_fallback(ep.arcflow, low)
    return ep, ratio, cut, ok

            if self.passes[j]:
                for s in range(self.elo[j], self.ehi[j] + 1):
                    pslot[s].append(j)
        self.pslot = pslot
        self.pairs = []
        for s in range(S):
            for j in pslot[s]:
                self.pairs.append((s, j))
        self.rset = self._ratio_set()
        self.assignment = [-1] * J
        self.nf = [0] * F
        self.nsel = 0
        self.utility = 0
        self.age = 0
        self.pot = None
        self.low = [0] * F

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _ratio_set(self):
        vals = set()
        for t in self.target:
            for k in range(t + 1):
                fr = Fraction(k, t)
                if fr <= 1:
                    vals.add(fr)
        return sorted(vals)

    def lowers(self, ratio):
        p = ratio.numerator
        q = ratio.denominator
        return [-((-p * ti) // q) for ti in self.target]

    # ---------------- certificate arc list --------------------------------
    def build_arcs(self):
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        tail = []
        head = []
        capa = []
        cost = []
        slot_blk = []
        for s in range(S):
            a = self.abase + 3 * s
            blk = [len(tail)]
            tail.append(self.R)
            head.append(a)
            capa.append(self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s])
            cost.append(0)
            blk.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(a)
            head.append(a + 1)
            capa.append(self.B)
            cost.append(0)
            if s + 1 < S:
                blk.append(len(tail))
                tail.append(a + 1)
                head.append(a + 3)
                capa.append(self.B)
                cost.append(0)
            else:
                blk.append(-1)
            blk.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(a + 1)
            head.append(a + 2)
            capa.append(self.qcap[s])
            cost.append(0)
            slot_blk.append(blk)
        dense_start = len(tail)
        times = self.times
        ready = self.ready
        value = self.value
        W = self.W
        wbase = self.wbase
        for s in range(S):
            e = self.abase + 3 * s + 2
            ts = times[s]
            for j in self.pslot[s]:
                tail.append(e)
                head.append(wbase + j)
                capa.append(1)
                cost.append((ts - ready[j]) - value[j] * W)
        dense_end = len(tail)
        win_arc = []
        for j in range(J):
            win_arc.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(wbase + j)
            head.append(self.zbase + self.wflow[j])
            capa.append(1)
            cost.append(0)
        flow_arc = []
        for f in range(F):
            flow_arc.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(self.zbase + f)
            head.append(self.fhead[f])
            capa.append(self.ceiling[f])
            cost.append(0)
        group_arc = []
        for g in range(G):
            group_arc.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(self.hbase + g)
            head.append(self.ghead[g])
            capa.append(self.gceil[g])
            cost.append(0)
        back = len(tail)
        tail.append(self.Z)
        head.append(self.R)
        capa.append(J)
        cost.append(0)
        self.slot_blk = slot_blk
        self.dense_start = dense_start
        self.dense_end = dense_end
        self.win_arc = win_arc
        self.flow_arc = flow_arc
        self.group_arc = group_arc
        self.back_arc = back
        self.tail = tail
        self.head = head
        self.capa = capa
        self.cost = cost
        self.narcs = len(tail)
        self.set_lowers([0] * F)

    def set_lowers(self, low):
        low arr = [0] * self.narcs
        for f in range(self.F):
            low_arr[self.flow_arc[f]] = low[f]
        self.low_arr = low_arr
        self.low = low

    # ---------------- feasibility circulation -----------------------------
    def build_aux(self):
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        n = self.K + 2
        self.SS = self.K
        self.TT = self.K + 1
        g = GL.Graph(n)
        amap = [g.add(self.tail[i], self.head[i], 0)
                for i in range(self.narcs)]
        base = [0] * len(g.cap)
        for s in range(S):
            blk = self.slot_blk[s]
            base[amap[blk[0]]] = self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s]
            base[amap[blk[1]]] = self.B
            if blk[2] >= 0:
                base[amap[blk[2]]] = self.B
            base[amap[blk[3]]] = self.qcap[s]
        for i in range(self.dense_start, self.dense_end):
            base[amap[i]] = 1
        for i in self.win_arc:
            base[amap[i]] = 1
        for gidx in range(G):
            base[amap[self.group_arc[gidx]]] = self.gceil[gidx]
        base[amap[self.back_arc]] = J
        ss_arc = {}
        for v in sorted(set(self.fhead)):
            ss_arc[v] = g.add(self.SS, v, 0)
        tt_arc = [g.add(self.zbase + f, self.TT, 0) for f in range(F)]
        self.aux_g = g
        self.aux_map = amap
        self.aux_base = base
        self.aux_ss = ss_arc
        self.aux_tt = tt_arc
        self.aux_n = n

    def feasible(self, low, need_cut=False):
        total = 0
        for l in low:
            total += l
        if total == 0:
            return True, None
        for f in range(self.F):
            if low[f] > self.ceiling[f]:
                capv = 0
            else:
                capv = self.ceiling[f] - low[f]
            if capv == 0 and low[f] > self.ceiling[f]:
                pass
            self._tmp_flow_cap = None
        cap = self.aux_base[:]
        amap = self.aux_map
        supply = {}
        for f in range(self.F):
            l = low[f]
            ce = self.ceiling[f] - l
            cap[amap[self.flow_arc[f]]] = ce if ce > 0 else 0
            if l:
                h = self.fhead[f]
                supply[h] = supply.get(h, 0) + l
            cap[self.aux_tt[f]] = l
        for v, amt in supply.items():
            cap[self.aux_ss[v]] = amt
        g = self.aux_g
        val = GL.maxflow(self.aux_n, g.adj, g.to, cap, self.SS, self.TT,
                         limit=total)
        if val >= total:
            return True, None
        if not need_cut:
            return False, None
        seen = GL.reachable(self.aux_n, g.adj, g.to, cap, self.SS)
        return False, [v for v in range(self.K) if seen[v]]

    def ratio_search(self):
        cands = self.rset
        lo = 0
        hi = len(cands) - 1
        best = 0
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            ok, _ = self.feasible(self.lowers(cands[mid]))
            if ok:
                best = mid
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid - 1
        return best

    # ---------------- min cost planning -----------------------------------
    def big_m(self, low):
        J = self.J
        vmax = 1
        for v in self.value:
            if v > vmax:
                vmax = v
        tmax = self.times[-1]
        return self.W * (J * vmax + 1) + J * (tmax + 1) + 1

    def dag_order(self):
        order = [self.R]
        for s in range(self.S):
            a = self.abase + 3 * s
            order.append(a)
            order.append(a + 1)
            order.append(a + 2)
        for j in range(self.J):
            order.append(self.wbase + j)
        for f in range(self.F):
            order.append(self.zbase + f)
        for g in self.group_topo():
            order.append(self.hbase + g)
        order.append(self.Z)
        return order

    def group_topo(self):
        G = self.G
        depth = [0] * G
        state = [0] * G
        for i in range(G):
            if state[i]:
                continue
            chain = []
            cur = i
            while cur >= 0 and state[cur] == 0:
                state[cur] = 1
                chain.append(cur)
                cur = self.gparent[cur]
            base = depth[cur] if cur >= 0 else -1
            for node in reversed(chain):
                state[node] = 2
                base += 1
                depth[node] = base
        return sorted(range(G), key=lambda i: -depth[i])

    def optimise(self, low):
        S, J, F, G, K = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G, self.K
        g = GL.Graph(K, costed=True)
        cimap = [0] * self.narcs
        for s in range(S):
            blk = self.slot_blk[s]
            for k in (0, 1, 2, 3):
                a = blk[k]
                if a < 0:
                    continue
                cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], self.capa[a], 0)
        odense = len(g.to)
        for i in range(self.dense_start, self.dense_end):
            cimap[i] = g.add(self.tail[i], self.head[i], 1, self.cost[i])
        owint = []
        for j in range(J):
            a = self.win_arc[j]
            owint.append(g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], 1, 0))
        P = self.big_m(low)
        urew = []
        urest = []
        for f in range(F):
            z = self.zbase + f
            h = self.fhead[f]
            urew.append(g.add(z, h, low[f], -P))
            urest.append(g.add(z, h, self.ceiling[f] - low[f], 0))
        ugrp = []
        for gidx in range(G):
            a = self.group_arc[gidx]
            ugrp.append(g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], self.gceil[gidx], 0))
        pot = GL.pot_from_dag(K, g.adj, g.to, g.cap, g.cost, self.dag_order())
        units, total, pot = GL.mincost_negative_augment(
            K, g.adj, g.to, g.cap, g.cost, pot, self.R, self.Z, J)
        cap = g.cap
        asg = [-1] * J
        pairs = self.pairs
        for t in range(len(pairs)):
            if cap[odense + 2 * t] == 0:
                asg[pairs[t][1]] = pairs[t][0]
        nsel = 0
        for j in range(J):
            if asg[j] >= 0:
                nsel += 1
        nf = []
        for f in range(F):
            a = urew[f]
            b = urest[f]
            nf.append((low[f] - cap[a]) + (self.ceiling[f] - low[f] - cap[b]))
        self.opt_g = g
        self.opt_pot = pot
        self.cimap = cimap
        self.odense = odense
        self.urew = urew
        self.urest = urest
        self.assignment = asg
        self.nsel = nsel
        self.nf = nf
        flow = [0] * self.narcs
        for i in range(self.narcs):
            if self.dense_start <= i < self.dense_end:
                continue
            if i in ():
                continue
            flow[i] = self.capa[i] - cap[cimap[i]]
        for f in range(F):
            flow[self.flow_arc[f]] = nf[f]
        for t in range(len(pairs)):
            if cap[odense + 2 * t] == 0:
                flow[self.dense_start + t] = 1
        flow[self.back_arc] = nsel
        self.arcflow = flow
        U = 0
        A = 0
        times = self.times
        ready = self.ready
        value = self.value
        for j in range(J):
            s = asg[j]
            if s >= 0:
                U += value[j]
                A += times[s] - ready[j]
        self.utility = U
        self.age = A
        return units

    # ---------------- potentials ------------------------------------------
    def residual(self, low):
        tail = self.tail
        head = self.head
        capa = self.capa
        cost = self.cost
        flow = self.arcflow
        lowarr = [0] * self.narcs
        for f in range(self.F):
            lowarr[self.flow_arc[f]] = low[f]
        radj = [[] for _ in range(self.K)]
        rto = []
        rcost = []
        for i in range(self.narcs):
            u = tail[i]
            v = head[i]
            x = flow[i]
            c = cost[i]
            if x < capa[i]:
                radj[u].append(len(rto))
                rto.append(v)
                rcost.append(c)
            if x > lowarr[i]:
                radj[v].append(len(rto))
                rto.append(u)
                rcost.append(-c)
        radj[self.R].append(len(rto))
        rto.append(self.Z)
        rcost.append(0)
        radj[self.Z].append(len(rto))
        rto.append(self.R)
        rcost.append(0)
        self.radjs = radj
        self.rto = rto
        self.rcost = rcost

    def potentials(self, low):
        self.residual(low)
        p = self.opt_pot[:]
        a = p[self.R]
        b = p[self.Z]
        t = a if a < b else b
        p[self.R] = t
        p[self.Z] = t
        GL.feasible_potential(self.K, self.radjs, self.rto, self.rcost, p,
                              [self.R, self.Z])
        for v in range(self.K):
            pv = p[v]
            if pv > LIMIT_POT or pv < -LIMIT_POT:
                return False
        return self.check_potentials(p, low)

    def check_potentials(self, p, low):
        tail = self.tail
        head = self.head
        capa = self.capa
        cost = self.cost
        flow = self.arcflow
        lowarr = self.lowarr_for(low)
        for i in range(self.narcs):
            u = tail[i]
            v = head[i]
            x = flow[i]
            c = cost[i]
            if x < capa[i] and c + p[u] - p[v] < 0:
                return False
            if x > lowarr[i] and p[u] - c - p[v] < 0:
                return False
        return True

    def lowarr_for(self, low):
        arr = [0] * self.narcs
        for f in range(self.F):
            arr[self.flow_arc[f]] = low[f]
        return arr

    # ---------------- cut -------------------------------------------------
    def cut_for(self, idx):
        cands = self.rset
        if idx + 1 >= len(cands):
            return None
        ok, seen = self.feasible(self.lowers(cands[idx + 1]), need_cut=True)
        if ok or seen is None:
            return None
        if not self.verify_cut(seen, self.lowers(cands[idx + 1])):
            return None
        return seen

    def verify_cut(self, cut, low):
        inside = [False] * self.K
        for v in cut:
            if v < 0 or v >= self.K:
                return False
            inside[v] = True
        lowarr = self.lowarr_for(low)
        ein = 0
        eout = 0
        tail = self.tail
        head = self.head
        capa = self.capa
        for i in range(self.narcs):
            u = tail[i]
            v = head[i]
            if inside[u]:
                if not inside[v]:
                    eout += capa[i]
            elif inside[v]:
                ein += lowarr[i]
        return ein > eout

    # ---------------- verification ----------------------------------------
    def verify(self, ratio, low, cut):
        S, J, F, G, K = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G, self.K
        flow = self.arcflow
        tail = self.tail
        head = self.head
        capa = self.capa
        lowarr = self.lowarr_for(low)
        if len(flow) != self.narcs:
            return False
        bal = [0] * K
        for i in range(self.narcs):
            x = flow[i]
            if x < 0 or x > capa[i] or x < lowarr[i]:
                return False
            bal[tail[i]] -= x
            bal[head[i]] += x
        for v in range(K):
            if bal[v]:
                return False
        pairs = self.pairs
        for t in range(len(pairs)):
            s, j = pairs[t]
            want = 1 if self.assignment[j] == s else 0
            if flow[self.dense_start + t] != want:
                return False
        for j in range(J):
            s = self.assignment[j]
            if s >= 0:
                if not self.passes[j] or s < self.elo[j] or s > self.ehi[j]:
                    return False
            else:
                for t2 in range(self.dense_start, self.dense_end):
                    pass
        if ratio != Fraction(1, 1):
            r = Fraction(1, 1)
            for f in range(F):
                fr = Fraction(self.nf[f], self.target[f])
                if fr < r:
                    r = fr
            if r != ratio:
                return False
        else:
            for f in range(F):
                if self.nf[f] < self.target[f]:
                    return False
        if not self.check_potentials(self.pot, low):
            return False
        if cut is not None and not self.verify_cut(cut, low):
            return False
        return True

    def report(self):
        return metrics.selected_report(self.flows, self.windows, self.preds,
                                       self.assignment)


def solve_epoch(bucket, slots, flows, groups, windows, preds, thresholds,
                value, W):
    ep = Plan(bucket, slots, flows, groups, windows, preds, thresholds, value, W)
    ep.build_arcs()
    ep.build_aux()
    idx = ep.ratio_search()
    ratio = ep.rset[idx]
    low = ep.lowers(ratio)
    ep.set_lowers(low)
    ep.optimise(low)
    ep.pot = None
    if ep.potentials(low):
        pass
    else:
        ep.pot = [0] * ep.K
        ep.potentials(low)
    cut = None
    if ratio < 1:
        cut = ep.cut_for(idx)
    ok = False
    try:
        ok = ep.verify(ratio, low, cut)
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    return ep, ratio, cut, ok

    def build_tree(self, g):
        """Segment tree over slot positions carrying the separable arc cost.

        Every certificate arc e_s -> w_j of cost (time_s - ready_j) - value*W
        is replaced by the unique tree path e_s -> leaf_s -> ... -> v -> w_j
        with the slot term on the intake arc and the window term on the last
        arc, so every path keeps exactly the certificate cost while the dense
        arc block shrinks from S*J to J*log S.  Tree capacities exceed any
        possible flow, hence the only saturated arc incident to w_j is the
        certificate arc carrying that window's assignment and the dual prices
        transfer to the certificate network unchanged.
        """
        S = self.S
        J = self.J
        cap = J + 1
        self.tleaf = {}
        self.trange = {}
        self.tkid = {}
        self.tarc = {}
        self.next_free = self.K
        root = self._tree_build(g, 0, S - 1, cap)
        self.tree_root = root
        for s in range(S):
            g.add(self.abase + 3 * s + 2, self.tleaf[s], cap, self.times[s])
        for j in range(J):
            if not self.passes[j]:
                continue
            lo = self.elo[j]
            hi = self.ehi[j]
            if hi < lo:
                continue
            bj = -self.ready[j] - self.value[j] * self.W
            w = self.wbase + j
            for nd in self._cover(lo, hi):
                g.add(nd, w, cap, bj)

    def _tree_build(self, g, l, r, cap):
        node = self.next_free
        self.next_free += 1
        self.trange[node] = (l, r)
        if l == r:
            self.tleaf[l] = node
            return node
        m = (l + r) // 2
        a = self._tree_build(g, l, m, cap)
        b = self._tree_build(g, m + 1, r, cap)
        self.tkid[node] = (a, b)
        self.tarc[node] = (g.add(a, node, cap, 0), g.add(b, node, cap, 0))
        return node

        """Tree nodes whose ranges partition the window slot range [lo, hi]."""
        out = []
